notes.title: New Demo Release!
notes.content:
Hello Engineers!

A big update to the Cubetory Demo just dropped. 

Notably, it includes : 
- New map generation : Smaller by default, but adjustable
- Metrics
- Power System improvements
- Balancing changes to recipes
- Sandbox mode
- Steam Cloud support
- Improved controls
- Custom map support

Please enjoy, and let me know in the discord if you run into any issues :)

notes.title: Small bugfix patch
notes.content:
A new version of the demo was just released. Changes of note :

The simulation engine changes should lead to much better performance on older PCs

Fixed issues with borderless windows and multiple monitors

Tweaked the tutorial to help with learning the mechanics

Tweaked keybinding to allow re-binding left click

Development of the full game is going well, and should be able to start internal testing in the discord sometime in august.

notes.title: Public playtest starts now!
notes.content:
Greetings engineers!

I'm happy to announce that the Playtest is now live. Here's a changelog from the previous playtest held in discord : 


 Progression cleaned up, the game is now based on rate of production.
 Added challenges to the desert biome.
 Fixed a variety of placement bugs
 Added high-contrast mode and mouseover indicators for colors
 Contextual hints appear in important menus
 Added a difficulty selection. Cube wizard is really hard.
 Various performance improvements


Please give it a shot and let me know what you think!

I'll be creating a special role in discord for anyone who beats the demo/playtest on the Cube Wizard difficulty for the hardcore automation fans among us.
